## TASK-012 - Implement stable term, read and search resolution

Implement stable-ID, exact-label, alias and lexical match ordering with approved exact matches protected, explicit no-match and candidate distinctions for ambiguity.

### Risks

- Preserve unrelated bytes and stop on stale inputs or a scope conflict.

### Acceptance criteria

- Repeated identical input returns stable ranked identities and match reasons without embeddings or services.
- Unknown, draft, deprecated and ambiguous results remain explicit; aliases reference existing IDs.

### Planned verification

- Run ordering, stable tie-break, ambiguous alias, no-match, draft and deprecated fixture queries.
- Compare JSON and human rendering identities, definitions, statuses and provenance.

### Risks

- Preserve unrelated bytes and stop on stale inputs or a scope conflict.

### Acceptance criteria

- health, term, search, read, neighbors, path and validate identify project/config/module/source state and preserve canonical/generated/configuration bytes and persistent timestamps.
- Missing configuration, invalid imports, stale/missing sources and absent projections receive specific diagnostics; valid empty extensions can query core.
- No command creates directories, repairs indexes, starts a backend or invokes a discovered capability.

### Planned verification

- Run every read command on fresh, stale, empty-extension and missing-generated-state fixtures and compare full persistent inventories.
- Change a bound source and verify stale authority is exposed; inspect supported --help syntax against command docs.
